nodes.label: GET /master/master-hierarchy/server-groups (Server Group Scoped Hierarchy)
nodes.rationale: Separate route rather than an extra filter on the base listing, because server_groups and is_active are required here (multi-tenant SAP server scoping is mandatory) while they are optional on the unscoped listing.

edges.source_location: same summary, response example and parameter set as the unscoped listing, with server_groups and is_active promoted to required
two different master resources solve the same problem the same way: a duplicated /server-groups listing route instead of a server_groups filter on the base collection
